name: ui/alert
title: Alert
summary: The registry alert: a message with role="alert", default or destructive. Title, description and action are its parts.

props.name: variant
props.description: destructive reads only the destructive token.

slots.name: default
slots.description: The content: an icon, the title and description parts, an optional action.

behaviour: An icon as the first child takes its own column beside the text.
An action part reserves room on the right.

focus: None: an alert does not take focus.

theming.brandOverlay: None: danger is never a brand colour.

noJs.without: Everything: the component is server-rendered HTML with no script.

contract:
contract
  slot is "alert"
  role is "alert"
  portal is "https://mzizi.dev/components/alert"
  class contains "bg-card"
  when default shows div "Heads up"
  when destructive class contains "text-destructive"
end
